verdict.rationale: CSC documents registered-agent coverage in all 50 states and DC and has per-location pages such as Delaware. None of the evidence shows those pages publishing the three things the story asks for: the state agent address, which form designates the agent, or who files it. The CSCNavigator Forms Library of secretary of state forms by entity type and state is an adjacent feature, not published per-state appointment details, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider publishes per-state appointment details: the agent address for that state, which form designates the agent, and who files it
